title: Equality of etale unit images reflects locally on X
statement: Let $X$ and $Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Write $b_i:X_{\Et}\to Z_{\Et}$ for base change, $i^*F$ for its sheaf inverse image with adjunction unit $\eta^{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction], and $j_X,j_Z$ for the open-subscheme inclusion functors. Suppose $A$ and $G$ are topological sheaves of sets on $X$ and $Z$, with presheaf isomorphisms $e_X:A\cong F\circ j_X$ and $e_Z:G\cong (i^*F)\circ j_Z$. For each open $W\subseteq X$, choose an isomorphism $a_W:j_Z(i^{-1}W)\cong b_i(j_X(W))$ of etale $Z$-schemes whose first pullback projection is the restricted morphism $i|_W:i^{-1}W\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define the function $r_W:A(W)\to G(i^{-1}W)$ by $r_W(s)=e_Z^{-1}((i^*F)(a_W)(\eta^{\Et}_{j_X(W)}(e_X(s))))$, where $(i^*F)(a_W)$ denotes contravariant restriction along the hom of $a_W$. For any $z\in Z$, open neighbourhood $W$ of $i(z)$, open neighbourhood $V$ of $z$ contained in $i^{-1}W$, and sections $s,t\in A(W)$, if the restrictions of $r_W(s)$ and $r_W(t)$ to $V$ agree, then there exists an open neighbourhood $W_0\subseteq W$ of $i(z)$ such that $s|_{W_0}=t|_{W_0}$. Restriction maps are those of the stated presheaves.

proof.text: *The unit as a class in the presheaf inverse image.* Write $i^{-1}F=(i_pF)^\#$ with sheafification map $\theta:i_pF\to i^{-1}F$, $i_pF(V)=\varinjlim_{(U,\varphi)\in\mathcal I_V^{op}}F(U)$ over the pairs of an object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$ and a $Z$-morphism $\varphi:V\to U\times_XZ$, coprojections $\iota_{(U,\varphi)}$, and restriction along $g:V'\to V$ sending $\iota_{(U,\varphi)}(s)$ to $\iota_{(U,\varphi\circ g)}(s)$ [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact] (1), [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-functor-sheaf-pullback-adjunction] (2). The adjunction $u_s\dashv u^s$ is the composite of $u_p\dashv u^p$, whose unit at $U$ is $\iota_{(U,\mathrm{id})}$ [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact] (1), and of sheafification $\dashv$ inclusion, whose unit is $\theta$; so the composite unit is $i^*s=\theta_{U\times_XZ}(\iota_{(U,\mathrm{id})}(s))$. Consequently, for $W\subseteq X$ open, $V\subseteq i^{-1}W$ open in $Z$ with inclusion $\varphi_V:V\to W\times_XZ$ (the given open/base-change identifications), and a $Z$-morphism $g:V'\to V$ of $Z_{\Et}$, the restriction of $i^*s$ along $\varphi_V\circ g$ is $\theta_{V'}(\iota_{(W,\varphi_V\circ g)}(s))$, since $\theta$ is a morphism of presheaves. Moreover each $\mathcal I_{V'}^{op}$ is filtered, because $X_{\Et}$ has finite limits and $U\mapsto U\times_XZ$ commutes with them [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits] (2), (3), [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-sets-left-exact] (2).

proof.text: *Key step: agreement on $Z$ near $z$ gives agreement on $X$ near $i(z)$* (source: 'As \'etale morphisms are open, the image of $U\to X$ is an open neighbourhood $U_0$ of $z$ in $X$. The map $\mathcal F(U_0)\to\mathcal F(U)$ is injective by the sheaf condition for $\mathcal F$ with respect to the \'etale covering $U\to U_0$'). Let $z\in Z$, $x=i(z)$, $W\subseteq X$ an open neighbourhood of $x$, $a,b\in F(W)$, and suppose $(i^*a)|_V=(i^*b)|_V$ in $(i^{-1}F)(V)$ for some open $V\subseteq i^{-1}W$ containing $z$. We show $a|_{W_0}=b|_{W_0}$ for an open $W_0\subseteq W$ containing $x$. By the preceding unit description, $(i^*a)|_V=\theta_V(p)$ and $(i^*b)|_V=\theta_V(q)$ with $p=\iota_{(W,\varphi_V)}(a)$, $q=\iota_{(W,\varphi_V)}(b)$ in $i_pF(V)$. As $\theta_V(p)=\theta_V(q)$, there is a covering $\{g_k:V_k\to V\}$ of $Z_{\Et}$ with $p|_{V_k}=q|_{V_k}$ for all $k$ [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local]. The covering is jointly surjective [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]: pick $k$ and $v\in V_k$ with $g_k(v)=z$. By the preceding unit description, $p|_{V_k}=\iota_{(W,\varphi_k)}(a)$ and $q|_{V_k}=\iota_{(W,\varphi_k)}(b)$, $\varphi_k=\varphi_V\circ g_k$. Since $\mathcal I_{V_k}^{op}$ is filtered (by the preceding step), [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise] (3) gives a morphism $(U,\psi)\to(W,\varphi_k)$ of $\mathcal I_{V_k}$, i.e. an $X$-morphism $g:U\to W$ from an etale $U\to X$ with $(g\times_XZ)\circ\psi=\varphi_k$, such that $a|_U=b|_U$ (restriction along $g$). Let $u'\in U$ be the image of $\psi(v)\in U\times_XZ$; as $\psi$ is a $Z$-morphism, $\psi(v)$ lies over $z$, so $u'$ lies over $x=i(z)$. The image $W_0$ of $U\to X$ is open [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map], contains $x$, and lies in $W$ because $U\to X$ factors through $g$. So $U\to X$ factors as $U\xrightarrow{u_0}W_0\hookrightarrow X$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme]; $u_0$ is surjective by the choice of $W_0$ and etale, being a morphism between schemes etale over $X$ [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale], [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (3). Hence $\{u_0:U\to W_0\}$ is a covering of $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The two morphisms $g$ and $(W_0\hookrightarrow W)\circ u_0$ from $U$ to $W$ become equal after composing with the open immersion $W\hookrightarrow X$, so they are equal [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-monomorphism]; therefore $(a|_{W_0})|_U=a|_U=b|_U=(b|_{W_0})|_U$ along $u_0$. The sheaf condition of $F$ for the one-member covering $\{u_0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] (the first map of the equalizer diagram is injective) gives $a|_{W_0}=b|_{W_0}$.

proof.text: Transport the sections using the presheaf isomorphism e_X. Its naturality identifies restriction in A with restriction in F, and its inverse reflects equality on W_0. The presheaf isomorphism e_Z and the projection compatibility of a_W identify the assumed equality with the equality used in the preceding step.

theorem gabber_zariski_etale_local_agreement
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (Fzar : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (max (u + 1) v)) X.carrier)
    (eX : Fzar.obj ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Comma.lift (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤) (W := ⊤)
        X.restrictFunctor (fun U => (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)) (fun _ => trivial)
        (fun _ => trivial)).op ⋙ F.obj)
    (iFzar : TopCat.Sheaf (Type (max (u + 1) v)) Z.carrier)
    (eZ : iFzar.obj ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Comma.lift (P := @Etale) (Q := ⊤) (W := ⊤)
        Z.restrictFunctor (fun U => (inferInstance : Etale U.ι)) (fun _ => trivial)
        (fun _ => trivial)).op ⋙
      ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
        (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj)
    (a : ∀ W : X.Opens, Scheme.Etale.mk (i ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≅
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι))
    (ha : ∀ W : X.Opens,
      (a W).hom.left ≫ pullback.fst W.ι i = i ∣_ W)
    (W : X.Opens) (z : Z.carrier) (hzW : i.base z ∈ W)
    (V : Z.Opens) (hzV : z ∈ V) (f : V ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s t : Fzar.obj.obj (op W))
    (heq : iFzar.obj.map f.op
      (eZ.inv.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj.map (a W).hom.op
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app F).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (eX.hom.app (op W) s)))) =
      iFzar.obj.map f.op
      (eZ.inv.app (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
            (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).obj F).obj.map (a W).hom.op
            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (max (u + 1) v))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (Z.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app F).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι)) (eX.hom.app (op W) t))))) :
    ∃ (W0 : X.Opens) (_ : i.base z ∈ W0) (g : W0 ⟶ W),
      Fzar.obj.map g.op s = Fzar.obj.map g.op t
